yorum: Beautiful grounds, wonderful breakfasts, and very responsive and kind staff. You feel their care and assistance. The only thing I really didn't like was the Folie beach club. It's a complete scam. Not only that, but the hotel photos in the description don't make it clear that this is a separate beach club from the hotel, where a sun lounger costs an extra 100 euros per person. I love piers and jumping into the water, so I looked at the photos and expected a pier, but it turned out to be this awful Folie club. We had lunch there. We left a $500 deposit at the hotel and were told we could spend it in the restaurant. However, at Folie, they told us otherwise. We had to go to our room for our wallet and come back to pay. After that, I wrote to the hotel administrator, who said we could have paid with the deposit; they simply made fun of us at Folie. I will never go back there.

I recently stayed at Mett Hotel and overall had a very pleasant experience. The hotel itself is beautiful, everything was spotless, and the staff were incredibly friendly and attentive throughout my stay. My only complaint is the food. Considering the price point of the hotel, I was expecting a much more impressive dining experience. The breakfast was quite underwhelming, with very limited buffet options and a small hot food menu. The dinner menu was also fairly boring and lacked variety. Other than the food, everything else was excellent and I genuinely enjoyed my stay. I would recommend the hotel for its service, cleanliness, and overall atmosphere, but if food is an important part of your holiday experience, this may be something to keep in mind.

Despite its scenic location, landscaped layout and stylish rooms, this hotel currently lacks the standards of a truly higher end offering. Staff are very polite and friendly but not at all experienced. Breakfast was quite lacklustre, despite the bounty and variety of local produce. Large cleaning carts parked in guest toilets, conversations interrupted with POS machines to settle extra charges in haste signal some training and managerial issues. The hotel group may be expanding a bit too fast and its service standard is not in keeping with a five-star at all.
